title: Dealing in securities by executive directors, prescribed officers and company secretary
summary: The post Dealing in securities by executive directors, prescribed officers and company secretary appeared first on Harmony Gold Mining Company Limited .
body_markdown:
**Johannesburg, Friday, 09 October 2026** . In line with the provisions of the 2018 Harmony Deferred Share Plan, executive directors, company secretary and prescribed officers of Harmony were awarded deferred shares on 18 September 2026 based on the 5-day volume weighted average price of R323.28 per ordinary share and accepted these awards on 8 October 2026. In addition, in compliance with paragraphs 6.77 to 6.80 of the JSE Listings Requirements, dealings in securities by executive directors, company secretary and prescribed officers are disclosed.


The following transactions are disclosed in relation to the deferred share awards:


1. Name of director: BB Nel (Group Chief Executive Officer)


Nature of transaction: Off market award of deferred shares


Periods of vesting: Deferred shares vest in five equal tranches over a five-year period


Class of securities: Deferred ordinary shares


Number of deferred shares awarded: 63 271


Total value of shares awarded: R20 454 294.96


Nature and extent of director’s interest: Direct beneficial
